name: Countfire
summary: Cloud takeoff for mechanical and electrical estimating teams, with estimates built from your own priced items.
differentiator: Built around PDF takeoff and a priced-items list that fills from your past work. Its savings calculator uses UK estimator day rates in pounds, and the pages do not say whether a US material database is included.
pricing: No price published on the pages we read.

scope.takeoff: Cloud PDF takeoff on PC or Mac. Counts thousands of symbols across all drawings in a project.
scope.library: Estimates start auto-populated from your previous items and products. No library count stated.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: The page says regularly used items "arrive priced" from your own history. No price feed is named.

bestFor: Estimating teams that want consistent takeoff and will carry their own prices.
skipIf: You want a prebuilt US electrical database and NEC-based assemblies.
watchOut: The company is UK-based and also lists a US phone line.
